sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Montgrony is a Catalan mountain sport crag near Gombrèn and Girona.

sections.heading: History and context
warnings: No sourced history and context content found for this pass.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: The source mix supports southwest and west-facing tufa climbing on limestone; the legacy packet emphasizes shorter, bouldery, cruxy routes.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: The legacy packet says Montgrony suits sport climbers looking for power-endurance tufa climbing rather than beginners-only mileage.

sections.heading: Grades and difficulty
sections.body: Legacy evidence says about 300 routes, while the external source reports about 200; routeCount is left null and gradeRange uses the external 5.9 to 5.14 span.

sections.heading: Season and conditions
sections.body: Legacy evidence supports autumn through spring, with south-facing walls and cold sunny winter days.
